title: Berlin Bathing Season - Quick Summary
items: **The official bathing season runs 15 May to 15 September**, with samples taken at all 39 official Berlin bathing sites every 14 days. After 15 September nobody is testing the water and no assessment is published.

**All 39 sites carry the top grade, so the grade cannot rank them.** It is worked out after each season from 40 results over four years and covers two gut bacteria only, Escherichia coli and intestinal enterococci.

**Blue-green algae are excluded from that grade by regulation** and assessed separately. 30 of the 39 sites are flagged for possible mass growth, and blooms build from July. Skip any patch with visible green streaks or mats, especially with children.

**14 sites carry a swimmer’s itch note.** The larvae come from waterfowl by way of shoreline snails, swarm once the water passes 20 degrees, and leave itchy wheals for up to three weeks. Feeding ducks at a bathing spot makes it worse.

**Water rescue is listed at 29 of 39 sites and only as present at times.** 10 sites list none, 24 are not screened from boat traffic, 10 have no toilet, 5 are step-free to the water, and 38 of the 39 forbid dogs outright.
